Get it running 🚀

  1. 1

    Download

    Tap the pink button above to save the .mcpack file to your device.

  2. 2

    Open with Minecraft

    Tap the downloaded file — Bedrock imports it straight into your resource packs.

  3. 3

    Activate & play

    In your world's settings, move it to Active Packs, load in, and enjoy the glow-up.
